questions.solution:
The acidity of carboxylic acid is& directly proportional to the acid dissociation constant. But it is inversely proportional to the ${pK}_{a}$ value because the ${pK}_{a}$ is equal to the $- {logK}_{a}$. So, the order of acidity of given acids depends upon the $- M, - I$ effect. It is directly proportional to the $- M, - I$ effect.&

The acetic acid is least acidic. So, it has the ${pK}_{a}$ value of $4. 76$. After that acidity of benzoic acid. So, it has the ${pK}_{a}$ value of $4. 19$. After that acidity of $p -$nitrobenzoic acid. So, it has the ${pK}_{a}$ value of $3. 41$. The compound ${F}_{3}CCOOH$ is most acidic. So, it has the ${pK}_{a}$ value of $0. 23$.
